Called meeting of City Council.
Austin Tex. July 11, 1874.

His Hon. J. B. Wheeler Mayor in the chair called the Council to order. The roll being
called the following Aldermen answered to their names: Alderman E. Bremond, G. T.
Boardman, Wm. Bouggerhoffe J.
Dohme H. McMety N. B. Mitchell and J. H. Robinson.
Absent Aldermen Col. Christian A. Scholp and S. H. Todd.
His Hon. the Mayor stated that the meeting had been called to take action in regard to
procuring dumping carts and appointing the additional police etc.
The Mayor appointed W. P. Allen Capt. A. H. Cox and M. L. Langford as policemen and
submitted their names to the board of Aldermen. On motion the appointments were confirmed.
Ald. Bremond moved that the Street Committee and Marshal be authorized to purchase two
carts and two mules or horses and make arrangements for the keeping of the same. Carried.
Ald. Bremond moved that the Street Committee be instructed and authorized to inspect the
Street Gas Lamps and if found according to contract to accept the same and report at the
next meeting. And that said Committee also distribute the old street lamps as they may see
proper. Carried.
Mr. Val. C. Giles was nominated by His Hon. the Mayor as city weigher and his name
submitted to the Board of Aldermen. On motion the nomination was confirmed.
On motion the Street Committee was instructed to select a place for the erection of the
public scales. and make report of the same at next meeting.
On motion Council adjourned.
Fred Sterzing
Recorder.
